annotations.text:
Three marks for decentralized.cloud — a router that quotes cloud compute capacity and prices it with evidence: every quote it returns carries the source that produced it, when it was observed, and when it stops being true.

Each concept is shown at full lockup, at 24px and 16px true scale, and in a product bar. Each states its own idea and its own cost. One of them will be built out; the other two will not.
